description: Na₆Pb₃P₄S₁₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R3m space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six S atoms. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.84-3.23 Å. Pb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four S atoms. There are a spread of Pb-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.02 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four S atoms. There are two shorter (2.06 Å) and two longer (2.07 Å) P-S bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four S atoms. There is one shorter (2.06 Å) and three longer (2.07 Å) P-S bond lengths. There are five inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Pb, and one P atom. In the second S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Pb, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing SNa₂PPb trigonal pyramids. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to three equivalent Pb and one P atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Na and one P atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one P atom.
